name: Ossian-B
description: Ossian-B is BioForge Labs' flagship CNT-organic hybrid substrate, produced by functionalizing single-wall carbon nanotubes with hydroxyapatite and collagen-analog proteins that trigger osteoblast adhesion and guided bone remodeling. When implanted adjacent to living bone, the material acts as a scaffold that the body progressively integrates — over six to eighteen months, host tissue grows into and through the CNT matrix, creating a true bone-nanotube composite stronger than either component alone. It is the foundational material for next-generation augment anchoring systems.
developers: licensed to several licensed augment manufacturers
story_hooks: A batch of counterfeit Ossian-B is circulating in Shelf-level chop shops — it looks identical but lacks the functionalization chemistry, meaning implants will fail to integrate and will eventually loosen catastrophically.
Someone has discovered that fully integrated Ossian-B implants can be tracked via a subtle electromagnetic signature — every person with the material in their body is a beacon.
BioForge Labs' osseointegration formula is the subject of a patent dispute; a smaller biotech claims the functionalizing chemistry was stolen from their research, and they have documentation.
